hypothesis: Weekly own-market momentum, unlevered spot, keep the same units through consecutive active weeks.
decision: Compare successive Saturday UTC daily closing prices. Submit modeled entry or exit on Monday UTC open, after all of Sunday elapsed.
rule_selection: Fixed prior to fetching or scoring these daily cuts. No fitting. Liquidate at the last Monday open per partition. Mark daily open at liquidation prices. Report all completed calendar weeks.
qualification: Later period must beat cash, passive and opposite in both scenarios. Positive results are historical simulations. No automatic promotion.
